load_model_from_single_file: load a pretrained model from a .ckpt or .safetensors single file checkpoint into a diffusers model class
load_unet_from_single_file: load a UNet2DConditionModel from a single file checkpoint with original config and torch dtype
load_flux_transformer_from_single_file: load a FluxTransformer2DModel from a single file checkpoint with default transformer subfolder
load_controlnet_from_single_file: load a ControlNetModel from a single file checkpoint with original config mapping
load_vae_from_single_file: load an AutoencoderKL VAE from a single file checkpoint with original config and default vae subfolder
load_sd3_transformer_from_single_file: load an SD3Transformer2DModel from a single file checkpoint with default transformer subfolder
load_model_with_quantization: load a model from a single file checkpoint with quantization config and auto quantizer preprocessing
load_model_low_cpu_mem: load a model from a single file checkpoint with low CPU memory usage using init_empty_weights and dispatch
